Money cha-ching / cash-register sound — sale, payment, profit, revenue, earnings, price, or financial-success reveal. Sync the initial register hit to the amount or confirmation appearing on screen; let the coin shimmer ring out. (Hyperframes Assets/Sound Effects, Pixabay licence or user-supplied)
Soft melodic chime — gentle positive beat: success/confirmation or a lighthearted transition. Sync to the visual moment. (Hyperframes Assets/Sound Effects, Pixabay licence or user-supplied)
Quiet short click — low-key UI tap / soft selection. Short accent, sync exactly to the on-screen action. (Hyperframes Assets/Sound Effects, Pixabay licence or user-supplied)
Crisp UI click — button press, toggle, selection. Short accent, sync exactly to the on-screen action. (Hyperframes Assets/Sound Effects, Pixabay licence or user-supplied)
Negative / error tone — failure state, a 'wrong' beat, or a glitchy interruption. (Hyperframes Assets/Sound Effects, Pixabay licence or user-supplied)
Punchy digital glitch — hard-cut accent or sudden reveal. Trigger on the hit; let the decay bleed into the next shot (J-cut). (Hyperframes Assets/Sound Effects, Pixabay licence or user-supplied)
Harsh, longer glitch — chaotic / jarring transition or a distorted reveal. (Hyperframes Assets/Sound Effects, Pixabay licence or user-supplied)
Low-key glitch texture — subtle digital shift, minimal transition that sits under other audio. (Hyperframes Assets/Sound Effects, Pixabay licence or user-supplied)
Bass impact hit — logo/hero snap, headline slam. Trigger on the visual landing; decay carries into the next shot (J-cut). (Hyperframes Assets/Sound Effects, Pixabay licence or user-supplied)

mood: Bass impact with a short swell
use: Bass impact with a short swell — brief anticipation then a deep hit. Place so the peak lands on the reveal. (Hyperframes Assets/Sound Effects, Pixabay licence or user-supplied)
Single key press — one keystroke / terminal-input beat. Short accent, sync to the typed character. (Hyperframes Assets/Sound Effects, Pixabay licence or user-supplied)
Notification chime — alert, message-in, toast/badge appears. Sync to the element entering. (Hyperframes Assets/Sound Effects, Pixabay licence or user-supplied)
Sharp electronic ping — punchy accent on a key reveal or data point. Sync to the beat. (Hyperframes Assets/Sound Effects, Pixabay licence or user-supplied)
Quick pop — element appear/spawn, chip/tag/badge in. Small precise accent, sync to the pop-in. (Hyperframes Assets/Sound Effects, Pixabay licence or user-supplied)

Short high-pitched riser (~1.9s) — sharper, more urgent hook for the very start of a short-form video. Trigger at 0s; pairs well with a fast title card or bold opening statement. (Hyperframes Assets/Sound Effects, Pixabay licence or user-supplied)

mood: Alternate short rising riser (~3.2s, normal pitch)
use: Alternate short rising riser (~3.2s, normal pitch) — hook for the start of a short-form video when 'riser-hook' has already been used elsewhere in the same series/reel and a variation is wanted. Trigger at 0s. (Hyperframes Assets/Sound Effects, Pixabay licence or user-supplied)

DEFAULT hook riser (~2.5s) — the go-to sound effect for the very start of any short-form video. Trigger at 0s under the opening line/title to grab attention before the first cut. Prefer this over 'riser-hook-alt' and 'riser-high-pitch' unless the piece specifically calls for a different character. (Hyperframes Assets/Sound Effects, Pixabay licence or user-supplied)

mood: Long cinematic riser (~10s build, peak at the end). Trigger at (climax_time − 10.03s) so it crests exactly on the reveal.
use: Long cinematic riser (~10s build, peak at the end). Trigger at (climax_time − 10.03s) so it crests exactly on the reveal. (Hyperframes Assets/Sound Effects, Pixabay licence or user-supplied)
Bright sparkle / shimmer — magical reveal or 'shine' highlight on a hero element. Sync to the highlight. (Hyperframes Assets/Sound Effects, Pixabay licence or user-supplied)
Typing burst (~1.5s of keys) — keyboard / code typing reveal, text-being-typed beat. Start as the text begins typing. (Hyperframes Assets/Sound Effects, Pixabay licence or user-supplied)
Cinematic whoosh build (~5.5s) — sweeping scene transition. Align so the swell peaks on the cut. (Hyperframes Assets/Sound Effects, Pixabay licence or user-supplied)
Short whoosh — quick swipe/slide accent, fast element move, snappy transition. Sync to the motion. (Hyperframes Assets/Sound Effects, Pixabay licence or user-supplied)
Punchy whoosh/impact — fast reveal or hard transition accent. Sync to the motion. (Hyperframes Assets/Sound Effects, Pixabay licence or user-supplied)
